text: The original PlayStation was a grey plastic rectangle that helped redraw the videogame industry. Thirty-plus years later, Sony and LEGO are selling the rectangle back to us — one brick at a time.

The officially licensed LEGO PlayStation contains 1,911 pieces and builds into a near-1:1-scale recreation measuring 26cm wide. It includes the original-style controller, functional Power and Open mechanisms and a cable that plugs the controller into the console.

alt: LEGO PlayStation with its disc lid opened to reveal a hidden Ape Escape diorama

text: Sony and LEGO hid references to Ape Escape and Gran Turismo inside the build. The Gran Turismo scene includes a miniature track and cars; the Ape Escape scene has a swappable red or blue light on the monkey’s helmet. Both dioramas can be removed and displayed separately.

alt: Person plugging a LEGO memory card into the LEGO PlayStation

text: At $179.99 / €159.99 / £139.99, this is plainly an adult collector object. Its value is recognition: the circular disc lid, memory-card slots and wired pad are shorthand for a specific era.

PlayStation says the set launches through PlayStation Direct in selected countries on 1 October 2026 . LEGO Insiders also get access October 1, with general LEGO.com and LEGO Store availability beginning October 4.
